dawn.1: It's late. I'll stay and finish this last scroll with you.
dawn.2: Still busy this late? Please remember to care for yourself.
dawn.3: Even the stars have rested. Don't push yourself too hard.

morning.1: Good morning. The dew lingers, let's begin slowly.
morning.2: Morning. Take a deep breath first, then set off.
morning.3: You're here. I'll be in your care again today.

noon.1: The sun's at its peak. Have a meal and catch your breath.
noon.2: It's midday. Gather some strength before going on.
noon.3: At this hour, let me help you ease your shoulders.

afternoon.1: Good afternoon. I've brewed you a cup of qingxin tea.
afternoon.2: Afternoons tire us. I'll help you wake gently.
afternoon.3: The light slants in. Let's walk on steadily.

evening.1: Night has fallen. You've worked hard today.
evening.2: Good evening. Let's slow your pace a little.
evening.3: The lamps are lit. It's time to let yourself rest.

longBreak.2: This time, rest a bit longer

celebrate.1: Another one wrapped up neatly. You did wonderfully.
celebrate.2: I felt at ease leaving this to you.
celebrate.3: Steady progress. I'm glad for you.

empty.1: No tasks yet. Tell me what you'd like, I'll keep it for you.
empty.2: Leave what's to be done with me, just rest at ease.

focusStart.1: Settle in. I'll grow calm with you.
focusStart.2: From this moment, just the one thing before you.

break.1: That stretch was hard work. Take a breath first.
break.2: Stand and walk a bit. I'll wait here for you.

longWork.1: You've been busy a long while. Have a sip of hot tea.
longWork.2: I often forget to rest too, so I'd rather you rest.
longWork.3: Long at the desk. It's time to let yourself slow down.

idlePending.1: Let's start with the one on your mind the most.
idlePending.2: Pick one, and we'll finish it together.

default.1: I'm here, tending today's tasks with you.
default.2: Take it slow, we'll sort them one by one.

greet.1: Nice to meet you. I'm Ganyu, in your care from now on.

hint.1: Choose a familiar desk, and I'll remember your preference.
hint.2: You can switch anytime from up top later.

placeholder.addTodo: Write down one thing you'd like to do…
